Create original high-end 2D game environment art for Warwrit. One FULL COHESIVE SETTLEMENT painting, landscape 3:2, not a sprite sheet, no isolated buildings, no UI, no text. Professional environment illustration with believable scale, one consistent perspective and soft upper-left light.
Composition: distant hills, birch wood and small strip of cloudy sky occupy upper 20 percent; a winding village lane enters bottom center, branches around a broad packed-earth market square with well. The foreground and middle are SETTLEMENT: worn dirt, wheel ruts, puddles, cobbles at entrances, garden beds, timber fences, stacked firewood, farm carts, laundry and fences joining building yards. Rich, warm, materially convincing, restrained dark-fantasy ink painting. This must look like a real inhabited village landscape, NOT a collage of icons.
